Welcome to the **Get Started** section. This page explains how to set up
eic-shell and join the ePIC software effort.

1. **Join GitHub:** [https://github.com/eic](https://github.com/eic)
* Contact [![emailicon](../assets/images/site/icons/email.png){: width="3%" }](mailto:eic-software-l-request@lists.bnl.gov) from your institutional email address.

## Install eic-shell

Run `curl -L get.epic-eic.org | bash` in an empty directory, then `./eic-shell`.
The container version is {{ site.data.software.version }}.

## Join a project

See the {% include navigation/findlink.md name='wiki' tag='ePIC wiki' %} to get involved.
